CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   B. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.
   B. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Ten Commandments? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Ten Commandments.
   C. Use The Ten Commandments to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Ten Commandments has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Call of Disciples? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Call of Disciples.
   B. Use The Call of Disciples to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Call of Disciples with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Call of Disciples has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Marriage and Family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Marriage and Family.
   D. Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
   B. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Jesus Christ.
   C. Say Miracles of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Miracles of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Ten Commandments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Stories Samson defeats the Philistines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Faith in God Elisha and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Jacob Wrestles an Angel and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

3. D — Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of The Ten Commandments with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of The Call of Disciples with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Miracles of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Ten Commandments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
